topic: What happens if you fall through thin ice?
title: Through Thin Ice
hook: What if the ice cracked under you?

beats.label: 1 MINUTE
beats.line: For the first minute, you gasp uncontrollably. Stay calm and breathe.

beats.label: 10 MINUTES
beats.line: You have about ten minutes before your arms and legs stop working.

beats.label: 30 MINUTES
beats.line: Blood pulls away from your hands to keep your heart and brain warm.

beats.label: 1 HOUR
beats.line: Only after about an hour does real hypothermia knock you out.

end.line: Did you know the one ten one rule?

description: One minute, ten minutes, one hour: the cold water rule that can save your life.

facts.claim: Cold shock causes an uncontrollable gasp and fast breathing in the first minute; staying calm helps.
facts.source: NIH / NCBI - Cold water immersion; Prof. Gordon Giesbrecht, University of Manitoba

facts.claim: The 1-10-1 principle: about 1 minute to control breathing, 10 minutes of useful movement, up to 1 hour before losing consciousness from hypothermia.
facts.source: National Center for Cold Water Safety; Gordon Giesbrecht

facts.claim: In the cold, blood vessels in the limbs narrow to keep the core warm.
